text:
lena (procurement): Heads-up: AlphaLogistics notified a partial delivery for AWB 5555-0001 arriving Tue 05:30 UTC. It's a mixed H200/A800 wave. Partial arrival = 36 units, remainder ~50 in ~4 business days. Staging needs >=40 to hit EU pool. We need a quick decision: accept partial + air-topup or expedite via FRA reroute. Also vendor flagged HS reclass to 8542.31 causing duties. @alpha-logistics any concrete duty estimate and options?

alpha-logistics (supply-broker): Confirmed — customs flagged HS 8542.31 (semiconductor modules) vs declared 8471.80; that triggered a duty variance. Estimated extra duty ~ $980 and potential 36-48h customs hold. Option A: reroute via FRA hub with expedited customs handling, uplift fee +$380, clears same day. Option B: accept partial and we can provide return labels for any DOA, or vendor can issue a $250/unit soft-fail credit for up to 3 units to avoid returns. If Redwood signs a one-time uplift of +5 units on next committed wave we'll waive the $380 fee. Portal: https://al-logistics.example/awbs/5555-0001

hiro (fleet): Can we accept 36? Staging target is 40. If we accept partial and wait for rest in 4 days we miss this pool. Air-topup would be 4 extra units (costly). Prefer reroute+waive if legal/finance ok.

marta (ops): Note: manifest shows 2 units with vendor soft-fail QC flags. Depot won't accept DOA without pre-created RMA and pdf labels. If we go FRA reroute we still need RMAs for the two. @rma-bot please start provisional RMA and list depot acceptance requirements.

rma-bot: provisional RMA created: #RMA-43043 for AWB 5555-0001. Depot requires: 1) serial manifest attached (CSV or inline), 2) return labels as PDF (4x6) attached to RMA, 3) photo evidence for any DOA, 4) signed credit/claim terms for DOA within 7 days. Missing PDFs => quarantine.

oli (finance): Quick numbers: reroute fee $380 waived if +5 uplift, duty +$980, soft-fail handling ~$150/unit. If vendor credit $250/unit for up to 3 units that offsets handling. Net (reroute + credit): $380 waived -> 0 + $980 duty + (2 * $150 handling = $300) - (2 * $250 credit = $500) = $780 net. If we wait, opportunity cost for delayed capacity estimated ~$2,400 (conservative).

nate (legal): We need an amendment: vendor liability for DOA within 7 days, credit terms spelled out, and explicit waiver of reroute fee tied to signed SOW uplift (+5 units). I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment and can fast-track a countersign if vendor sends written acceptance. No open indemnities.

lena (procurement): Actionable: vendor to confirm in writing the +5 uplift waiver, provide the +5 serials (so we can pre-stage), and push PDF return labels for the 2 soft-fail units to RMA-43043. If all yes, we go reroute and accept partial.

alpha-logistics (supply-broker): Can confirm in-thread: we'll waive the $380 reroute fee conditional on Redwood signing the SOW amendment for +5 units uplift in next committed wave. We'll provide the +5 serials by EOD and upload PDF 4x6 return labels to RMA-43043 right now. We'll also attach the updated commercial invoice with HS 8542.31 note for customs. Signed amendment to follow. :white_check_mark:

marta (ops): Posting manifest snippet for the depot (please reconcile full list when you upload):

```
AWB: 5555-0001
partial units arriving (36):
- H200-SN-100401
- A800-SN-200822  (soft-fail QC)
- A800-SN-200823  (soft-fail QC)
- ... (total 36)
```

Reminder: depot rejects non-PDF labels. rma-bot will auto-close ticket if labels not attached within 2 hours of arrival.

rma-bot: reminder: attach PDF return labels (4x6). Without labels depot_quarantine = true. RMA-43043 status = pending_evidence.

hiro (fleet): Good — if vendor uploads serials and labels and legal signs amendment we proceed reroute+clear. Please ping when SOW is in Docusign.

alpha-logistics (supply-broker): Uploaded: return_labels_RMA-43043.pdf and uplift_serials_+5.csv. Commercial invoice updated. Sending signed amendment draft to @nate for countersign via secure link. ETA attachments pushed to RMA ticket. :thumbsup:

lena (procurement): Thanks all. I'll coordinate the SOW signature with Nate and Oli. If we get the signed amendment we accept reroute and move units into staging window. Will update channel after countersign.
